successful.title: Payment Successful
successful.body: Your payment for order with checkout ID {checkoutId} has been received successfully.

failed.title: Payment Failed
failed.body: Your payment for order with checkout ID {checkoutId} has failed. Please try again.

buyer.title: Order Cancelled
buyer.body: Your order #{orderId} has been cancelled. Reason: {reason}

status_updated.title: Order Status Updated
status_updated.body: Your order #{orderId} status has been updated to {status}.

processing.title: Refund Processing
processing.body: Your refund of {amount} DZD is being processed

completed.title: Refund Completed
completed.body: Your refund of {amount} DZD has been completed. Money will arrive in 3-5 business days.

cancelled.title: Refund Cancelled
cancelled.body: Your refund request has been cancelled. {adminNote}

approved.title: Refund Approved
approved.body: Your refund request for order #{orderId} has been approved. Amount: {amount} DZD

rejected.title: Refund Rejected
rejected.body: Your refund request for order #{orderId} has been rejected. Reason: {reason}

bulk_deletion_failed.title: Bulk Deletion Partially Failed
bulk_deletion_failed.body: Failed to delete the following user IDs: {failedIds}. Please check the logs.

generated.title: Invoice Generated
generated.body: Your invoice for order {orderId} has been generated and is available.

generation_failed.title: Invoice Generation Failed
generation_failed.body: Failed to generate invoice for order {orderId}. Please contact support.
